fields.Name: T175 - Run Test Execution Dialog
fields.Description: Renders the ng-testing test-run-dialog execution panel (tags, variables, verbose/parallel options) opened via TestingDialogService — a distinct configuration surface, not test execution itself.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Runs" tab and click the "Run Test" button (or, in the Test Explorer, the Run button on a test card). Verify a "Run Test" slide panel opens showing the test-run configuration UI — options like a Verbose checkbox, an optional Run Tags section, and (when applicable) a Test Variables or test-selection section. Seeing the run-configuration dialog render is success — do NOT actually start/execute a run. Close the panel afterward. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Run Test opens a slide panel titled for running a test
The panel shows run-configuration controls (e.g. a Verbose option and/or a Run Tags section, or a test-selection/variables area)
The panel can be closed without starting a run
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
